item.title: Conditional Imaging for Privacy-Preserving Visual Sensing
item.description: arXiv:2610.28835v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Conventional visual sensing faces a fundamental dilemma: information that should remain private today may need to be recovered tomorrow. This challenge is becoming increasingly important as cameras become pervasive in our daily surroundings. Existing safeguards either protect visual content only after an image is formed or suppress information during capture in ways that prevent its later recovery.
